tasks.label: UI Ascended: Build + Hot Reload (scripts)
tasks.command: dotnet build -c Debug; if ($?) { Copy-Item 'bin\Debug\StationeersUIAscended.dll' 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stationeers\BepInEx\scripts\' -Force; Write-Host 'Deployed to BepInEx\scripts (ScriptEngine will hot-reload, or press F6 in game)' }

tasks.label: UI Ascended: Deploy (plugins)
tasks.command: dotnet build -c Release; if ($?) { Copy-Item 'bin\Release\StationeersUIAscended.dll' 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stationeers\BepInEx\plugins\' -Force; Write-Host 'Deployed to BepInEx\plugins' }
